assistiveTechnologyTests.procedure: Follow the documented procedure and listen for the information under test.

title: Grid row count is not updated when the full list opens
description: The verified observations grid reports five rows while four records are collapsed. Expanding it renders thirteen rows in total, but the alpha variant leaves aria-rowcount at 5, so assistive technology reports a shorter list than the one on screen.
expectedBehaviour: A grid reports the number of rows it contains, and the count stays correct when rows are added.
actualBehaviour: aria-rowcount remains 5 after the remaining nine rows are revealed.
userImpact: Screen-reader users are told the list has five rows and may stop navigating before the extra records.

wcag.note: The exposed row count no longer reflects the rendered grid.

detection.note: The initial state is correct; only the post-expansion state is wrong.

observed.note: Page-level axe run with tags wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa and best-practice. No violation was reported; the control on the same page also passes.

manualTests: Expand the grid with a screen reader running and listen for the reported row count.

assertions: aria-rowcount stays 5 while 13 rows are rendered.
tests: tests/responsive-and-state.spec.js: keeps the alpha row count stale

reviewStatus.note: A Playwright regression test preserves the defective behaviour and its control. That is automated reproduction, not a manual or assistive-technology observation.
